title: 第二十五章 抓捕方拙贾环抉择第二十六章 私自处理系统奖励
slug: 红楼我乃宗师贾环当登基为帝
lines: 唐氏有一门手段。
寻味追踪！
比贾环的痕迹追踪还要精细。
贾环把追踪方拙的事情交给唐羽，但见唐羽拿出一个小罐子。
罐子中装着一只奇怪的昆虫。
昆虫两条触须很长，像蟋蟀又像螳螂摸样。
“这是何物？”贾环问。
“大人，这是我们唐氏独门的东西，名叫百里虫，他能闻到一种香粉，跟踪这种香粉，百里内都能找到。”
说着，唐羽拿出一条细小的红绳，梆在了百里虫的身体上。
百里虫从罐子中跳出来，一下就蹦跶到唐叁的尸首上，嗅了嗅，闻了闻。
然后开始跳走。
“跟上！”
众人立即就跟上了百里虫。
“唐叁一旦发现自己有生命危险，袖子里的香粉就会撒出，方拙绝对不知道这种手段，这是我们唐氏这两年来专研出来的。”
说是专研，倒不如说是家族中有人得到这种奇怪的虫子，把虫子利用上的。
当年唐心跟方拙走的时候，他们还不会这种手段，所以唐羽断定方拙并不清楚。
百里虫的速度很快，跳跃一次，犹如人行两步。
贾环带着人紧紧的跟着，这一路往城门口而去。
“好个方拙，杀了人，这是想要离开京师逃跑啊！”
周旭等人眼见跟到城门，立即觉察到方拙可能是要离开京师，逃离此地。
唐羽满怀信心：“他逃不掉的。”
众人一路跟着出京师。
百里虫好像越来越兴奋了，跳的更快更远。
“不远了！”
唐羽双目开始张望。
贾环立即命令下面的人，四面散开，不要集中在一起，防止惊动了方拙，让他给跑了。
百里虫继续跳动。
京师城外，来往的人群也是很多的，还有众多商队。
而这会，百里虫就是跳往一个商队之中。
“找到了，在商队！”
唐羽言毕，就见一阵迷雾从商队之中传出。
方拙阴藏在其中，看到唐羽等人，立即觉察不对，散出一阵迷雾。
content_en:
The Tang family has a trick.
Follow the trail!
It's even more detailed than Jia Huan's trace tracing.
Jia Huan handed over the matter of tracking Fang Zhuo to Tang Yu, but saw Tang Yu take out a small jar.
There is a strange insect in the jar.
The two tentacles of the insect are very long, like a cricket or a praying mantis.
"What is this?" Jia Huan asked.
"Sir, this is our Tang's unique thing. It's called thyme bug. He can smell a kind of fragrant powder. If you follow this fragrant powder, you can find it within a hundred miles."
With that said, Tang Yu took out a small red rope and tied it on Baili Chong's body.
The thyme jumped out of the jar, jumped onto Tang San's body, sniffed and smelled.
Then start jumping away.
"Follow up!"
Everyone immediately followed Baili Chong.
"Once Tang San finds out that his life is in danger, he will spill the fragrant powder from his sleeves. Fang Zhuo definitely doesn't know this method. This is what our Tang family has developed over the past two years."
To say that it was a special research, it would be better to say that someone in the family got this strange bug and made use of it.
When Tang Xin and Fang Zhuo left, they didn't know how to use this method, so Tang Yu concluded that Fang Zhuo didn't know.
Thyme worms are very fast, jumping once is like walking two steps.
Jia Huan and his people followed closely, all the way to the city gate.
"What a Fangzhuo. He killed someone because he wanted to leave the capital and escape!"
Seeing Zhou Xu and others following them to the city gate, they immediately realized that Fang Zhuo might be leaving the capital and fleeing from here.
Tang Yu was full of confidence: "He can't escape."
Everyone followed him all the way out of the capital.
The thyme seems to be getting more and more excited, jumping faster and farther.
"Not far!"
Tang Yu started to look around.
Jia Huan immediately ordered the people below to spread out in all directions and not to gather together, so as not to alarm Fang Zhuo and let him run away.
The thyme continues to beat.
Outside the capital city, there are also many people coming and going, as well as many caravans.
At this moment, Baili Chong jumped into a caravan.
"Found it, in the caravan!"
After Tang Yu finished speaking, he saw a burst of fog coming from the caravan.
Fang Zhuoyin was hiding among them. When he saw Tang Yu and others, he immediately realized something was wrong and a burst of mist erupted.
title_en: Chapter 25: The decision to capture Fang Zhuo and Jia Huan Chapter 26: Handling system rewards privately
